standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.

💛 You hold Dispatcher's headset. You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Aria opens the pantry wide: 19× Burdock, 3× Expedition haul. Kai, Kwame, Freya, Elif and 2 more eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing over them. (−3,210 kcal from the pantry) Owen stayed in their tent, feverish. The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Living Wire is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
FEASTED ×2.03: the feast was the weapon.
FEASTED ×2.03: Kai's blow carries the feast.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
